This general affiliates program is for members to promote the full catalogue of dash. products, (Bags, Small Leathers, Jewelry, Apparel & Stationery) through a wide variety of media channels. Affiliate members will receive commission for every purchase made on dash. website through their unique affiliate link.

Please note that default commission payout method is PayPal. Bank Transfer is available for Thailand-base Affiliate Members only.

—————

About dash.
dash. is a lifestyle brand for those who wants to cut through the noise and focus on what matters. We strip away the excess to help you live better, with products designed to make life smoother, smarter, and stress-free.  Our mission - To turn everyday into effortless joy. Because life’s already complicated enough.

dash.
Created for everyday wear, dash. bags and small leather items are created for everyday wear. Our practical, minimalist design makes each item useful and convenient to use on a daily basis. The unisex design effortlessly integrates into any wardrobe. Discover the magic of simple, elegant design with dash.

What makes dash. different?:
• Simple - Timeless, Minimalist design that always stays relevant
• Practical - Useful & Convenient functions made for everyday use
• Universal - Simple products designed for anyone, at any age & for any occasions.

Commissions & Payments
• 10% Commission on any sales
• 30 days tracking period
• Payment is calculated every calendar month
• Commission paidout every 5th of the following month
• Payout via Paypal (Bank Transfer available for Thailand-based affiliates only)

Gifts & Perks
• Free sample products is available and will be offered to select affiliates. dash. reserves the rights to determine the appropriate products for their affiliate.

Learn more about dash at dashbrand.co
